markets.question: Top WR Fantasy Football Week 1 (PPR)
markets.description: This market will settle to Yes if Jakobi Meyers records the most fantasy points among all wide receivers (WR) in Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season. Fantasy points will be calculated using ESPN's Fantasy Football League Points Per Reception (PPR) scoring system and reflect each player's total for Week 1 of the 2026 Pro Football regular season. If two or more players tie, each tied player's market will settle at $1.00 divided by the number of tied players. If the listed player does not play for any reason, the market will settle to No. Outcome sourced from ESPN.
